fields.description: The name of the time range in the labour agreement (night, Sunday...). Left empty, the wage type holds every time range that has no row of its own.
fields.label: Time Range

fields.description: The wage type of the payroll that carries it. The model catalogue of the Swiss payroll standard (Swissdec, Lohnstandard-CH 6.0) offers, for the hours over, 1060 « Travail supplémentaire », 1061 « Heures supplémentaires à 125% » and 1065 « Heures supplémentaires »; for the time ranges, among others, 1073 (Sunday work), 1075 (night service) and 1076 (night work). The choice is yours, with your payroll's own chart.
fields.label: Wage Type

fields.description: Where the choice comes from: the catalogue, your payroll consultant, your agreement. Nothing is paid on a nature that has no row.
